title: A New Neighbor at the Front Desk
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方考试）。先读短文，注意be动词的否定句和一般疑问句。然后完成8道阅读题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。请按顺序作答，答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A: This is a small apartment building. Mr. Lee is the building manager. He is at the front desk.

B: A new person comes in. Her name is Anna. She is from China. She is a student. She is not a teacher. She has a small bag.

C: Anna asks, “Is this the front desk?” Mr. Lee says, “Yes, it is.” Anna asks, “Are you the manager?” Mr. Lee says, “Yes, I am.” Anna asks, “Is there a bus stop near here?” Mr. Lee says, “No, there is not. But there is a train station. It is not far.” Anna says, “Thank you.” Mr. Lee says, “You are welcome.”

grammar.title: be动词的否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: 英语中，be动词（am/is/are）的否定句是在be动词后加not，如“She is not a teacher.”。一般疑问句是把be动词提到主语前面，如“Is this the front desk?”。回答时用简短肯定或否定：Yes, it is. / No, it is not. 注意主语和be动词的搭配：I am, you are, he/she/it is, we/they are。
grammar.example: She is not a teacher. Is this the front desk? Yes, it is.

questions.explanation: 否定句在be动词后加not，所以是“She is not a student.”。
一般疑问句把be动词提前，所以是“Is he a manager?”。

questions.prompt: Answer the question: Are you a student?
questions.explanation: 问“Are you...?”时，肯定回答用“Yes, I am.”。

questions.prompt: Answer the question: Is she a teacher?
questions.explanation: 否定回答用“No, she is not.”。
否定句在are后加not，所以是“They are not here.”。
一般疑问句把are提前，所以是“Are they students?”。

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with one word: ______ she a doctor?
questions.explanation: 主语she是第三人称单数，be动词用is，疑问句提前，所以填Is。

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with one word: We ______ not from China.
questions.explanation: 主语we是复数，be动词用are，否定句在are后加not，所以填are。
